name: lich-typescript
description: TypeScript / JavaScript language adapter for Lich. Maps biome rule IDs (~423 rules) into M-engine outputs and contributes TS-specific idiom rules (React hooks exhaustive deps, JSX a11y, narrow-type-guards, any-avoidance). At launch: ~80 of biome's 423 rules mapped; remaining tagged as Phase 2 coverage gap.
